name: voidmaiz
description: The node-graph view and interaction layer for Void Core applications: it draws a mantle as a graph, turns every gesture into a visible dispatcher command, and owns no model state of its own.

requires.name: voidcore
requires.note: the model, the dispatcher and the state document. Desktop links the sibling's prebuilt libvoidcore.dll; an Android or cross build compiles the pure-C sources into a static lib instead, since there are no prebuilts for that substrate.

requires.name: voidallomone
requires.note: the derivation language, extracted from this repo 2026-08-29. Compiled from source with add_subdirectory and re-exported into maiz:: through forwarding headers, so hosts saw no change. Not yet published.

interacts_with.name: voidcore-reduce
interacts_with.note: voidmaiz_reduce is a C++20 port of Void Core's portable reduce contract, tested against its pure-JSON cases at ../VoidCore/conformance/reduce/cases. No link and no shared binary — the seam is the case format. 17 of 25 cases pass as of 2026-09-01; boxes, the reserved separator and the patch rule are not ported yet.

update.note: a library, not an installed product: hosts vendor or sit beside it and ship their own updates. The update section here describes what its applications inherit, not something Void Maiz updates on its own.
